notes.title: Last floor
notes.content: Added a settings window next to the list of levels, in which you can select how many floors you need to go through to escape.

notes.title: New event - special forces assault.
notes.content:
The order was given to storm the place of the spread of the virus, but the fighters are sent not to save the survivors...
Special forces will attack everyone: zombies, monster, even player, so you need to be careful with these guys.
They have suppressed MP5 with attached flashlight. This weapon help to avoid noise and see in darkness.

The team is very accurate, so you should hide from them - added possibility to crouch.

During development, there were problems with the code, 
so some game elements had to be re-done, all the errors found were fixed, 
however, there may be differences from the previous version of the game. 
The game has links through which you can contact the developer: tell about bugs, suggest ideas, etc.

notes.title: Errors fix, game upgrade, new content.
notes.content:
New event for floors - fire.
Added animations:
	Zombies:
		Smooth get up animation.
	Player:
		Different animations for weapon pick up.
		Walk in different ways.
		Edited push animation.
	Monster:
		Player eat animation.
New weapons: 
	Extinguisher 
	Bottle
Updated gameplay: 
	Player can throw weapons.
Edited main menu:
	Added numbers near audio sliders.
	Edited levels list showing.
	Instead of gamepad button will be correct for Pause.
Other:
	Cardreader have light, which show door condition (opened, closed). 
	Background blur when aiming.
Probably can be not listed updates.
For future update will be created new floor event and, probably, new game mode with limited count of floors.
